cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Reopen the First Reason
cards.instruction: Keep them present by returning to the first reason for staying and revealing that it now means something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Stay until the tea cools. You always rush goodbye.

mechanism: Copy a guest's tea-cooling gesture as a reason to stay, then transform the completed cooling task into a request for an unhurried goodbye.
confusable: Not merely delaying departure with fresh tea: the same first cooling reason must acquire a relational meaning after the copied gesture is corrected.
comparison: A departing guest offers five quiet minutes, unlike a former housemate offering to test a returned key.
seedUse: Retains tea cooling as pretext for a more present goodbye; introduces copied blowing on already-cold tea.
